record_title: Torsion-lift criterion and Henselian classification for commutative generalized quasi t-fine rings
provenance: A commutative classification of generalized quasi t-fine rings via torsion-unit reduction, with an exact Henselian residue-field criterion and a sharp localization/completion contrast.
limitations: The result is restricted to commutative rings and does not settle the noncommutative quasi t-fine versus fine problem. Hensel lifting and roots-of-unity lifting are standard prior art; originality is claimed only for their application to the newly introduced generalized quasi t-fine property and the resulting exact criteria. A later source revision or concurrent note remains the principal residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
